title: Shared templates
intro: Quizzes the hosts of this instance have shared. Taking one puts an independent copy in your bank — yours to rename, cut and present. Nothing is pushed back to you afterwards.
empty: No template has been shared on this instance yet. Share one from a quiz marked “ready”.
takeFailed: Could not take a copy of this template.

withdrawConfirm.title: Withdraw this template?
withdrawConfirm.description: It leaves the catalogue, so nobody takes it again. The copies people already took are theirs and are not touched.

shareConfirm.title: Share this quiz as a template?
shareConfirm.description: A copy goes to this instance’s catalogue. Other hosts take their own copy and change it as they please; your quiz is never modified by what they do. Sharing again later replaces the entry, and withdrawing it never removes the copies already taken.
